text_block_list.text:
A few days after helping Огури Кэп get
back to her dorm, a familiar
distraught
face can be seen wandering the academy
grounds.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hrmmm... I'm back here again...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, could you show me the way again?
I'm trying to get to the
training course this
time.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I lead Огури Кэп directly to the training
course.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait, Tama.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
About time ya showed up, Oguri! A bit
late, but I'm prouda ya, findin'
your way
here all by yourself!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I was worried you'd get lost again. And
y'know, since I can't go 'round
leadin' ya
everywhere, I thought it'd be a good idea
to try leavin' ya
to your own devices...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I got here just fine. This trainer here
showed me the way.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
AND HERE I THOUGHT YA DID IT ON
YOUR OWN!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's fine. Now that you're here, let's
hurry up 'n' get this
scrimmage started.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Sounds good. I'll go get ready.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: A'ight. Me too.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
A racer of the utmost caliber, Tamamo
Cross has already made her
debut, and she
looks ready to prove to Огури Кэп
precisely why.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Word of their race quickly spread around
the academy, and rightfully
so—both
participants are racers of remarkable
talent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear the news? Tamamo and
the new girl are gonna race
over at the
practice grounds!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Seriously?! You mean we finally get to see Oguri Cap in action? We gotta see this.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's awfully loud here. Is there some kind of
festival going on today?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: They're all here to see you two race.

text_block_list.text: Is... that so? That's quite the crowd...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Hrmm...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Errr, well... I've never been watched by so
many people around my
age. It wasn't like
this back home...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: I'm not used to it... It's making me restless.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's the same whenever I eat... The other
girls are always staring at the
mountain of
food on my plate...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
And it kinda bothers me, so I've been
eating alone in my room
lately...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Sorry for holdin' ya up, Oguri! I'm rea—
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Whoa! The stadium's packed, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Um, Tama?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
What? Don't tell me ya got butterflies,
Oguri! How're ya s'posed to
run in any of
the G1 races?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I got just the thing for ya! All ya gotta do
is imagine that eeeveryone
watching ya is
a piece of takoyaki!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Takoyaki, huh? Hm... I'll give it a shot.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Hrmmm... Now I'm hungry...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Ya sure are one peculiar gal...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Finished with their preparations, the
scrimmage between Огури Кэп
and Tama
Cross can finally begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hnng!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I'll show ya what a girl from Naniwa's really
made of!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Each of their steps digs deep into the
ground. It may be just a
scrimmage, but it
looks like neither of them are holding back
in this
800 meter dash.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Nngh!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started, Oguri!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
They overtake each other again and again,
until finally—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... A perfect tie, huh? Not bad, Oguri.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You too, Tama. You're faster than I
expected.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Right? But I'm gonna beat ya next
time, just ya wait and see.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
...Anyway! Now that I'm all fired up, might
as well go for a quick run.
Catch ya later,
Oguri!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс
Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: What a great race. Good job.

text_block_list.text: Ah, you were watching, huh?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's weird. Doctors told me I had a steady
heart. Even right after a
race, my heart
rate would go straight back to normal.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
But... my heart's still pounding. And when I
think about the race just
now, my heart... it
races even faster.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's a strange sensation, but... I think I like
it. Am I... excited? Is this
what excitement
feels like?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: You found yourself a worthy rival.

text_block_list.text: A rival... Huh...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: I see. So this is what central has to offer...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп stood in place, deep in
thought, reflecting upon this
brand-new
experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
